2608.07188.title: SetEasy: A Multi-Modal Classroom Engagement Assessment and Seating Optimization Framework
2608.07188.paper_summary: SetEasy optimizes classroom engagement in fixed seating grids. It fuses multimodal sensing (wristband physiology, 4K video, environmental data) and trains a v-Gage model grounded in a revised ISEQ. Each week, two-week engagement forecasts are mapped to a student-seat utility matrix, and CP-SAT generates seating plans under visual-access and social-dynamics constraints. In a four-week deployment (23 students, 331 classes), v-Gage converged across affective, behavioral, cognitive, and overall dimensions, cutting RMSE from 0.75 to 0.53. Optimization raised mean engagement from 0.30 to 0.70, with over two-thirds of seats reaching high engagement and back-row low-activity patterns markedly reduced. These results show that, without hardware changes, interpretable, data-driven seating strategies can substantially enhance engagement. The multimodal "assessment + optimization" paradigm offers a transferable, sustainable path to culturally responsive, differentiated spatial design amid global homogenization.
2608.07188.paper_summary_zh: SetEasy 優化了固定座位網格中的課堂參與度。它融合了多模態感測（手環生理、4K 視頻、環境數據），並訓練了一個基於修訂版 ISEQ 的 v-Gage 模型。每週，兩週的參與預測被映射到學生-座位效用矩陣中，而 CP-SAT 在視覺接觸和社會動態約束下生成座位計劃。在為期四週的部署中（23 名學生，331 堂課），v-Gage 在情感、行為、認知和整體維度上收斂，將 RMSE 從 0.75 降至 0.53。優化將平均參與度從 0.30 提高到 0.70，超過三分之二的座位達到高參與度，後排低活動模式顯著減少。這些結果顯示，在不改變硬體的情況下，可解釋的、數據驅動的座位策略可以顯著提高參與度。多模態的「評估 + 優化」範式提供了一條可轉移、可持續的路徑，以應對全球同質化中的文化響應性和差異化空間設計。
